LESSON: READING 7.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are pictures and photographs important in written texts?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension
2. appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING 7.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING: VISUALS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING 7.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING: VISUALS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals to a partner. (skill: appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are pictures and photographs important in written texts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading 7.2.1 Independent Reading: Visuals means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify types of information conveyed by visuals for comprehension.
5. Be able to: appreciate the importance of visual interpretation skills in different texts.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
